fields.label: Homepage — Hero subtext
fields.value: Craft bespoke celebration hampers, select artisanal sweets, clay-brass diyas, and premium relics wrapped in gold foiled rigid boxes.

fields.label: Homepage — Mission section headline
fields.value: To Help You Create Wonderful Stories

fields.label: Homepage — Mission section body
fields.value: Our vision is to revolutionize the art of gifting by creating personalized and memorable experiences that celebrate life's special moments — from birthdays and anniversaries to weddings, Diwali, and everything in between. Based in New Delhi, with one-day delivery available in Jaipur.

fields.label: About — Hero intro paragraph
fields.value: The Box Story was founded to transform gifting from a simple transaction into a meaningful, curated experience. Every hamper we create is built to tell a story, celebrate relationships, and spark joy.
